KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.3: Did you see him fly by earlier? I was half-way to the mountains. I was ready to enroll with the Black Knights.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.3: But it's the Moon Sprites' nature to want to help. They were raised that way. I woke up this morning and one had fixed a hole in my undergarments!
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.2: They took me in when I was found lost and dying, just wandering the desert with no memory to speak of.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.1: I like our Elder, Ancamairon, I really do. But he's too young and inexperienced.
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.1: I'm not naive enough to think Fuzan is going to leave us alone just because we're the furthest camp from him.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.3: All I had was this weird little bracelet with a name on it. Carved from bone, by skilled hands. I wonder who made it. Maybe they'd know who I am.
KeysToEntries.CitizenC.Incidental.2: I'm packed and ready to run whenever his shadow falls on the camp.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.2: I mean, I get it: both Uzzer and Manafem are headstrong in their own ways.
KeysToEntries.CitizenA.Incidental.1: This clan may be relatively new, and untested, but a kinder group you couldn't hope to find.
KeysToEntries.CitizenB.Incidental.1: The other camps are really missing out on Moon Sprites.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.2: It should have been Domri or Valas. Real citizens who know what is needed to survive in the Umbral.
KeysToEntries.CitizenD.Incidental.3: They would have worked WITH Fuzan, not rebel like teenagers.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.1: I left my parents in Uzzer. They wouldn't come with me to Alcarrid - said that the journey was too much for them.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.2: I can't face thinking about them back there. They don't agree with the decisions of the Elder, Gaimbín, but they have no choice but to remain.
KeysToEntries.CitizenE.Incidental.3: I'm saving for a wagon, so I can go back for them. I pray to the River Goddess that there's still time.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.1: Alcarrid is so beautiful. The other camps can't hold a light to it.
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.2: Manafem is picturesque, but the people are so sad. That's before you consider the sandstorms...
KeysToEntries.CitizenF.Incidental.3: Uzzer is fine, but it's a market hub. They're more concerned with crossing palms with coin than being pleasing to the eye.
